metadata.simplification: mapshaper -simplify interval=16 keep-shapes -clean (display only, topology preserved); districts dissolved from the simplified subdistricts; provinces dissolved then simplified at interval=120 for the country view
metadata.areaSqm: production value from base info; never recomputed from the simplified outline
metadata.limits: Administrative frames for navigation and aggregation of this dataset; not an official boundary certificate.
metadata.provinceFrames: 7 covered provinces dissolved from their subdistricts (unchanged); 70 others from the production PROVINCE outline (GET …/restaurant/info/geom/{uuid}/PROVINCE), simplified at interval=300 m for the country view (display only)
